# google_cloud_trace_sink

Describes a sink used to export traces to a BigQuery dataset. The sink must
be created within a project.

~> **Note:** The Cloud Trace API addresses a sink by its canonical resource
name, which references the project by its project **number**, not its project
ID. The `project` field must therefore be set to the project number, and the
BigQuery `destination` must reference the project by number as well.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about Sink, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/trace/docs/reference/rest/v2beta1/projects.traceSinks)
* How-to Guides
    * [Trace data exports overview](https://cloud.google.com/trace/docs/trace-export-overview)

## Example Usage - Cloud Trace Sink Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {
  provider = google-beta
}

resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "example" {
  provider   = google-beta
  dataset_id = "trace_sink_dataset"
  location   = "US"
}

resource "google_cloud_trace_sink" "example" {
  provider = google-beta

  # The Cloud Trace API references the project by its number, not its project ID,
  # both for the sink itself and for the BigQuery destination.
  project = data.google_project.project.number
  sink_id = "my-trace-sink"

  output_config {
    destination = "bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/${data.google_project.project.number}/datasets/${google_bigquery_dataset.example.dataset_id}"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `output_config` -
  (Required)
  The export destination.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_output_config).

* `sink_id` -
  (Required)
  The client-assigned sink identifier, unique within the project. Becomes the
  final component of the sink's resource name. Sink identifiers are limited to
  256 characters and can include only alphanumeric characters, underscores,
  hyphens, and periods.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_output_config"></a>The `output_config` block supports:

* `destination` -
  (Required)
  The destination for writing trace data. Currently only BigQuery is
  supported. The project in the destination must be referenced by its
  project **number**, not its project ID, e.g.:
  `bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_NUMBER]/datasets/[DATASET]`.
  The referenced dataset must already exist.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{sink_id}}`

* `name` -
  The canonical sink resource name, using the project number, of the form
  `projects/{{project_number}}/traceSinks/{{sink_id}}`.

* `writer_identity` -
  A service account name for exporting the data. This field is set by
  sinks.create and sinks.update. The service account will need to be granted
  write access to the destination specified in the output configuration; see
  Granting access for a resource. To create tables and write data, this
  account needs the `dataEditor` role. E.g.:
  `export-00000001@12345.iam.gserviceaccount.com`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Sink can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{sink_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{sink_id}}`
* `{{sink_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Sink using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    sinkId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_cloud_trace_sink.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Sink using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{sink_id}}"
  to = google_cloud_trace_sink.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Sink can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_sink.default projects/{{project}}/traceSinks/{{sink_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_sink.default {{project}}/{{sink_id}}
$ terraform import google_cloud_trace_sink.default {{sink_id}}
```
